shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a vertical rectangular field
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry shallow relief motifs that include round disc/ring-like forms and curving band or volute shapes, the sort of thing any relief tradition might produce. Otherwise the content is wholly different — A depicts a massive three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a few sparse, isolated emblematic signs (a ring, arcing bands, paired curls) across its back, while B is a flat panel filled by a dense, regularly repeating vertical band of vegetal ornament with palmettes, fan-like fronds, spirals and rosettes on linked stems.
